captions.caption: Elegant and sophisticated Latin jazz piece with a Cuban base and a whispered melodic female voice.

The song has a spanish jazz blues vibe that uses a bunch of instruments to complement the vocals, bass and acoustic melody which one can listen to while relaxing having a glass of wine either in a bar or at home
